_readme: DRAFT product descriptions for review — not used by the site until approved. Keyed by product slug. Merged 2026-10-20 with the edited content brief. status: ready = import as written (Admin → Products → Excel, description column); held = keep the current live text until the client answers the 'check' question ('proposed' is kept only as a starting point for then). 'why' and 'check' are for the reviewer only.

lamb-leg---bone-in.proposed: Whole frozen lamb leg on the bone, for roasting whole, slow-braising or cutting into curry pieces. Cooking on the bone keeps the meat moist and gives a richer gravy, so it suits carvery stations, Sunday roasts and festive menus.
check: Its web address has a triple hyphen (/products/lamb-leg---bone-in). Changing the slug to lamb-leg-bone-in tidies it; the old address redirects automatically.

lamb-leg-boneless.proposed: Frozen boneless lamb leg, ready to roll and tie for an even roast, butterfly for the grill, or dice for curries and kebabs. With the bone already out, there is little trim and every portion carves cleanly.

lamb-sq-cut-shoulder-slices.proposed: Square-cut lamb shoulder sliced into chops. Shoulder carries more marbling than leg, so these slices stay juicy on the grill or barbecue and turn tender when braised or cooked in a curry.

mutton-cube.proposed: Frozen diced mutton, cut into cubes ready for curries, stews, biryani and kebabs. Mutton has a deeper flavour than lamb and rewards long, slow cooking.

mutton-leg-bone-in.proposed: Frozen mutton leg on the bone for slow roasting, braising and curries. The bone adds flavour to the gravy and keeps the meat moist through long cooking, which suits biryani and celebration menus.

mutton-leg-boneless.proposed: Frozen boneless mutton leg for dicing into curries and biryani, mincing, or rolling and slow-roasting. Lean leg meat with the bone removed, so portioning is quick and waste is low.

pasta.proposed: Mezzi gomiti, or half elbows, are short curved pasta tubes: the classic shape for macaroni and cheese, baked pasta and cold pasta salads. The hollow centre fills with cheese and cream sauces.
check: This product's web address is /products/pasta. Changing its slug in the admin to donna-chiara-mezzi-gomiti-elbow-macaroni gives it a descriptive address; the site redirects the old one automatically.

premium-cooking-cream.proposed: Mavee's Premium Cooking Cream for savoury cooking: creamy pasta sauces, soups, curries, gravies and gratins. Made for hot dishes, it adds body and a rich finish to sauces in hotel, restaurant and café kitchens.

silver-sweetened-whipping-cream.proposed: Mavee's Silver Sweetened Whipping Cream, a ready-sweetened whipping cream for cake decoration, piping, fillings and desserts in bakeries, pastry kitchens and cafés.
check: What sets Silver apart from Smooth (sweetness, stability, pack, price tier)? This text claims no difference; one line each would let the two pages say more.

smooth-sweetened-whipping-cream.why: Description only repeats the product name
smooth-sweetened-whipping-cream.proposed: Mavee's Smooth Sweetened Whipping Cream, a ready-sweetened whipping cream for frosting cakes, filling pastries and topping desserts and drinks.

dedicato-gnocchi.proposed: Dedicato gnocchi is a dried durum-wheat pasta shaped like small ridged dumplings, from Granoro's 100% Puglia line. The ridges and hollow hold tomato, meat and cream sauces, and it bakes well.
check: Is this Granoro's dried durum-wheat pasta shape called gnocchi, or potato gnocchi? The current text calls it potato dumplings; 'proposed' is the version for the dried pasta shape.

azizaa-basmati-rice-5kg.why: 5 kg and 20 kg pages are 68% identical
azizaa-basmati-rice-5kg.proposed: Azizaa basmati rice in a 5 kg bag, a handy size for restaurants, cafés, smaller kitchens and retail shelves. Long, fragrant grains that cook separate and fluffy for biryani, pilaf, fried rice and curries. Also available in a 20 kg bag.

azizaa-basmati-rice-20kg.why: 5 kg and 20 kg pages are 68% identical
azizaa-basmati-rice-20kg.proposed: Azizaa basmati rice in a 20 kg bag for hotels, caterers and high-volume kitchens: the same long, fragrant grain as the 5 kg pack, in a size made for buffets, banquets and daily biryani service.

generic-aluminium-container-with-lid-750.why: 750 ml and 1,200 ml pages are 67% identical
generic-aluminium-container-with-lid-750.proposed: 750 ml rectangular aluminium container with a lid, sized for a single takeaway meal: a rice and curry portion, a pasta bake or an individual dessert. Also available in 1,200 ml for sharing portions.

generic-aluminium-container-with-lid-120.why: 750 ml and 1,200 ml pages are 67% identical
generic-aluminium-container-with-lid-120.proposed: 1,200 ml aluminium container with a lid for family-size takeaway orders, sharing portions and catering: larger servings of rice, biryani, pasta bakes and curries. Also available in 750 ml for single meals.

generic-cheese-slice-128s.proposed: Processed cheese slices in a 128-slice pack for high-volume kitchens: quick-service burger lines, breakfast sandwiches, toasties and room service. The slices melt evenly. A 90-slice pack is also available.

generic-cheese-slice-90s.proposed: Processed cheese slices in a 90-slice pack, a practical size for cafés, sandwich counters and smaller kitchens: burgers, melts, wraps and breakfast plates. For busier kitchens there is a 128-slice pack.

albertos-albertos-flour-tortilla-wraps-1.why: Clearer uses; from the edited brief
albertos-albertos-flour-tortilla-wraps-1.proposed: Soft 10-inch flour tortillas in packs of six, for burritos, large wraps and quesadillas. Warm them briefly on a dry pan before filling so they fold without cracking. A 6-inch pack of eight is also available for tacos.

albertos-albertos-tortilla-wraps-6-8s.why: Clearer uses; from the edited brief
albertos-albertos-tortilla-wraps-6-8s.proposed: Soft 6-inch flour tortillas in packs of eight, for street-style tacos, fajitas and smaller wraps. A few seconds on a hot pan keeps them soft and pliable for folding. For burritos there is a 10-inch pack of six.
